controls.name: systemMessage
controls.description: Append, replace, or customize prompt sections. Not part of the general live options patch.

controls.name: skipCustomInstructions
controls.description: Control custom-instruction inclusion independently of prompt replacement.

controls.name: availableTools
controls.description: Include bare names or source-qualified tool selectors. Live patches use arrays, not ToolSet builders.

controls.name: excludedTools
controls.description: Remove selected tools from exposure; exclusions win over inclusions.

controls.name: toolSearch
controls.description: Configure tool-search enablement and defer threshold without replacing its implementation.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: tools
controls.description: Declare custom tools, schemas, optional handlers, and explicit replacements.

controls.name: overridesBuiltInTool
controls.description: Opt into same-name built-in replacement. Use the bare tool name, not a source-qualified filter.
controls.stability: High-level SDK; bounded by runtime reservations

controls.name: handler
controls.description: Application execution callback. Handlerless declarations require explicit pending-request resolution.

controls.name: parameters
controls.description: Raw JSON Schema, Zod-like schema, or omitted parameters. defineTool itself is not an argument-validation wrapper.

controls.name: defer
controls.description: Choose auto or never for a tool's deferred exposure behavior.

controls.name: isTerminal
controls.description: Declare that a successful tool should end the agent turn.

controls.name: mcpServers
controls.description: Supply approved local or remote MCP integrations and their tool scopes.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: rpc.tools.set
controls.description: Replace this connection's external wire declarations, not its local SDK handler map.

controls.name: workingDirectory
controls.description: Choose a client or session working directory. A live session directory change uses the options patch.

controls.name: attachments
controls.description: Supply file, directory, selection, or blob context with a sent message.

controls.name: largeOutput
controls.description: Control oversized-result handling; enabled defaults can spill to temporary files.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: enableConfigDiscovery
controls.description: Explicitly opt into configuration discovery. The documented default is false, even with the coding client mode.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: enableSkills
controls.description: Enable or disable skill behavior independently of an allowed skill tool name.

controls.name: skillDirectories
controls.description: Supply reviewed skill directories; this is distinct from a lazy service-backed skill provider.

controls.name: pluginDirectories
controls.description: Supply explicit plugin directories even when ambient discovery is disabled.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: disabledMcpServers
controls.description: Suppress configured servers; a resident resume cannot use this field to stop already-running servers.
controls.stability: High-level SDK; not a shutdown operation

controls.name: session.plugins.reload
controls.description: Refresh the runtime's declared component subset, not every capability or host callback atomically.

controls.name: customAgents
controls.description: Declare specialist prompts, tools, models, skills, and MCP configuration.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: agent
controls.description: Choose the initial custom agent; separate select/deselect RPCs can change selection.

controls.name: defaultAgent
controls.description: Configure root-agent behavior; excludedTools hides from the primary agent without excluding the tool from children.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: customAgents[].model
controls.description: Choose a specialist model preference. Unavailability can fall back to the parent model rather than hard-fail.
controls.stability: High-level SDK; not a strict no-fallback policy

controls.name: model
controls.description: Select the session model; prefer the public session.setModel method for live changes.

controls.name: reasoningEffort
controls.description: Select supported reasoning effort for the model.

controls.name: contextTier
controls.description: Select a supported model context tier.

controls.name: provider
controls.description: Configure the provider endpoint and credentials. Updating wire configuration does not register new host token callbacks.
controls.stability: Live patch experimental; callback binding is separate

controls.name: rpc.model.setAllowedModels
controls.description: Apply session-level model allowlisting; CAPI identifiers intersect repository policy.
controls.stability: Experimental; not a per-agent fallback switch

controls.name: gitHubToken
controls.description: Supply a client or session GitHub identity. Session scope differs from process identity.
controls.when: Client / create / resume; not live patch

controls.name: gitHubTokenProvider
controls.description: Provide refreshable session credentials; mutually exclusive with a static session token.

controls.name: useLoggedInUser
controls.description: Decide whether client authentication may use the logged-in user's credentials.
controls.stability: High-level SDK; empty mode does not disable it automatically

controls.name: bearerTokenProvider
controls.description: Supply provider bearer tokens on demand; this is separate from the GitHub session token provider.

controls.name: onPermissionRequest
controls.description: Bind the application's permission policy. Omission can leave requests pending for explicit resolution.

controls.name: hooks
controls.description: Intercept supported lifecycle, prompt, and tool stages with application callbacks.
controls.stability: High-level SDK; not an inner-loop replacement

controls.name: managedSettings
controls.description: Supply startup policy; it is not persisted and must be supplied again rather than treated as an ordinary live option.
controls.stability: Not a general mutable configuration field

controls.name: onUserInputRequest
controls.description: Handle user interaction, including the ask_user surface when available.
controls.stability: High-level SDK; requires a real host handler

controls.name: onElicitationRequest
controls.description: Handle structured host elicitation requests.

controls.name: sessionId
controls.description: Choose a session identity at creation or identify the session to resume.
controls.stability: Identity, not a live rename field

controls.name: infiniteSessions
controls.description: Configure persistence and compaction behavior; enabled by default, including in empty mode.
controls.when: Create / resume; not general live patch

controls.name: sessionFs
controls.description: Configure client-side session filesystem conventions and capabilities.

controls.name: createSessionFsProvider
controls.description: Bind an actual host storage provider for each session when sessionFs is configured.
controls.stability: Experimental; not a no-op storage substitute

controls.name: mode
controls.description: Choose the empty or copilot-cli client baseline; this is separate from runtime interaction mode.
controls.when: Client construction, not a live profile switch

controls.name: baseDirectory
controls.description: Choose an explicit local state base for a client-owned runtime.

controls.name: sessionIdleTimeoutSeconds
controls.description: Configure server-wide idle-session cleanup, not the timeout of a model turn.

controls.name: streaming
controls.description: Enable delta delivery at session setup. The live options patch uses the different name enableStreaming.

controls.name: onEvent
controls.description: Attach a creation/resume-time host observer.

controls.name: session.on
controls.description: Subscribe to typed session events and unsubscribe locally as the host UI or workflow changes.

controls.name: responseFormat
controls.description: Newer provider-native per-turn format contract, not present in this Node SDK projection; output remains text.
controls.stability: Runtime contract; provider and schema limitations

controls.name: Harness methods and evals
controls.description: Choose domain methods, evaluation data, thresholds, and release policy outside a turnkey SDK field.
controls.stability: Host-owned responsibility, not an API property

gaps.title: Serve skills directly from a CMS
gaps.summary: A host wants to fetch tenant-specific skills from its service when needed, instead of shipping folders.
gaps.runtime: Directory inputs and implemented native skillProvider.list/read. The inspected Node SDK projects DTOs, but no high-level option or callback group was found.
gaps.boundary: Do not call this purely a missing runtime implementation. The gap spans ergonomic host bindings and a content contract currently limited to text-only SKILL.md, not related assets.
gaps.opportunity: Expose supported per-session provider callbacks in each SDK and define asset, ownership, and lifecycle semantics. Until then, a host can materialize reviewed files through the existing directory seam.

gaps.title: Store sessions in a product database
gaps.summary: A product wants session state in its existing encrypted database, under its own retention and data-governance rules.
gaps.runtime: The host-provided filesystem-shaped session interface, including its path conventions and optional SQLite operations.
gaps.boundary: This is not 'no pluggable storage exists.' The limitation is the abstraction level and adapter work required. Removing project tools does not remove session-state requirements.
gaps.opportunity: Define a narrower session-store contract with explicit durability and concurrency semantics, if real workloads justify it. Keep the current filesystem adapter path documented and supportable.

gaps.title: Swap tool implementations and packs live
gaps.summary: A long-running host wants to replace every resource in a pack while sessions continue, with one consistent effective version.
gaps.runtime: Live external declaration updates, explicit inputs, resume-time callback binding, and a declared plugin reload path for installed state/skills, MCP, agents, hooks, and configured extensions.
gaps.boundary: tools.set does not replace the SDK handler map. Plugin reload's declared fan-out omits rules/LSP. Built-in registration is startup-scoped. disabledMcpServers on resident resume does not stop running servers.
gaps.opportunity: Define per-session versioned resource snapshots, mutability rules, and atomic replacement/restart behavior across component types rather than promising a universal reload.

gaps.title: Reuse an arbitrary foreign plugin unchanged
gaps.summary: A team wants a package from another agent ecosystem to behave identically in its own product without repackaging or semantic changes.
gaps.runtime: Defined manifest precedence, exact-schema selection, portable skills/MCP, and Copilot-specific component discovery under its namespace.
gaps.boundary: Spec-mode warnings are not strict conformance certification. The manifest's extensions data map is distinct from executable JS extension directories.
gaps.opportunity: Co-develop portable component contracts and explicit adapters, backed by behavior fixtures. State exactly which semantics are preserved and which are host-specific.

gaps.title: Consume validated typed output everywhere
gaps.summary: A business workflow needs a typed final result with predictable failure behavior across supported providers and language clients.
gaps.runtime: The newer provider-native format contract. The host can separately parse and validate output where its chosen runtime/SDK path exposes the required behavior.
gaps.boundary: No universal fallback is promised. Factory-subagent schema support is a different surface from a general final-response contract.
gaps.opportunity: Complete language projections and define a portable typed-result/error contract. Keep provider limitations and host validation explicit rather than silently returning success-shaped fallbacks.

gaps.title: Replace the inner execution algorithm
gaps.status: Internal seam, not a public replacement API
gaps.summary: An integrator wants to replace the inner scheduling, retry, or request-processing algorithm rather than configure the behavior running inside it.
gaps.runtime: Public prompt/tool/agent/hook configuration and host-owned outer orchestration. Internal Rust traits compose native model dispatch, tool invocation, processors, and event sinks.
gaps.boundary: An internal trait is not evidence of a supported SDK override. This does not prevent an application from scheduling its own sessions or workflows outside the inner loop.
gaps.opportunity: Identify a narrow policy or scheduling seam justified by concrete workloads, or deliberately keep the outer control plane with the host. Avoid exposing the entire internal loop as an unstable callback framework.
